scope: Post-audit test-only isolation for the real pinned LLguidance matcher-padding probe. The prior v15 GPU audit used the runner and test source hashes recorded in CLI-GRAMMAR-RAW-AUDIT-BACKUP-2026-10-16.json; no GPU rerun was performed for this test-only change.

change.reason: load_pinned_grammar_registry prepends runtime/dependency paths to sys.path and imports pinned runtime modules. Running it in the combined unittest process could shadow modules from another source checkout for later tests.
change.fix: Run the single actual LLguidance dependency/matcher probe in a fresh python -B subprocess with PYTHONPATH removed, an explicit auditor file path, and explicit runtime/profile/registry/dependency arguments. Verify imported tokenizer/grammar modules are rooted under the pinned runtime, LLguidance is rooted under the pinned dependency, and the parent sys.path/sys.modules are unchanged.

retained_setup_failures.cause: The approved runner was invoked directly without Bash; execution stopped with Permission denied before tests.
The run directory had been pre-created, so the approved runner refused it before tests.
